meta.prompt_prefix: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the scene fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge as a single full-bleed image — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is the same continuous scene rendered dark, smoky and free of detail so overlay text stays readable, while all faces, flags, weapons and key objects sit entirely within the upper five-eighths. Anything held or carried sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. photoreal current-affairs broadcast composite: every person, flag and location is a real photograph, sharp and true to life — faces keep real skin texture, pores, stray hair and natural shadow, and fabric keeps a visible weave. Over that photographic base sit broadcast graphic treatments: a bold colour field, cracked-glass shards, torn and scorched edges, a hard vignette, heavy atmospheric haze and fire glow. Dramatic hard lighting, one dominant colour drowning the frame, every part of the upper five-eighths packed edge to edge with elements and no empty space, cinematic wide-angle, very high contrast. NOT an oil painting, NOT brushwork or impasto, NOT a matte painting, NOT anime, NOT an illustration, NOT a 3d render
meta.prompt_suffix: no title overlay text, no captions, no subtitle bars, no lower-third news banner, no watermark. Apart from the Korean Hangul labels and numerals named above — which must be rendered crisply and correctly as real Korean letterforms — do not invent any other words or letterforms anywhere in the image.
meta.negative_prompt: oil painting, brushwork, impasto, painterly, matte painting, illustration, anime, 3d render, cartoon, english text, latin letters, fake chinese characters, gibberish text, random lettering, invented words, glowing eyes, eyes lit with light, rising-sun ray flag, taegeuk flag burning

thumbnails.composition: 중앙 집중 (압수품 더미) + 제복 인물 클로즈업
thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄: 「전부 걷어 갔는데 더미 한가운데 화면 하나가 아직 켜져 있다.」 2026.8.21 등록된 중국 손전화까지 전량 회수(데일리NK) 장면. 회수는 승리가 아니라 수세라서 부정형으로 판정했다. 얼굴을 세우는 자리는 국가원수 다음 순위인 제복 집단(국가보위성 요원)이고, 단속당한 청년은 무명 민간인이라 전경에 세우지 않는다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: the North Korean State Security officer is the largest thing in the picture — his head and shoulders occupy the entire right third of the frame, his face alone spans roughly the top 55 to 60 percent of the frame height, the top of his cap touches the upper edge and is very slightly cropped by it, and his shoulder leaves the frame on the right. The other officers behind him are far smaller, roughly one third of his head height. Scene: a windowless night inspection room in a North Korean border county. An enormous North Korean flag — broad red band with a white circle bearing a red five-pointed star, thin white and blue stripes above and below — fills the entire left half of the frame from top to bottom, real woven fabric with deep folds, its edges charred black and soot-stained, desaturated and grimy. In front of it, at mid frame height, a heaped wooden crate overflows with hundreds of confiscated feature phones, MP3 players and USB sticks piled like scree; the crate's side panel is stencilled "회수품" in Korean Hangul in large characters. Every device is dead and dark except one, buried in the middle of the heap, whose small screen still burns cold blue and throws a thin blue light up onto the officer's chin. Behind them a wall of black smoke and low orange fire glow packs the frame with no empty space; a hairline crack runs across the flag's fabric like broken glass. The officer stands directly in front of the flag in olive-drab uniform with red collar tabs, one gloved hand gripping the crate rim at mid height. His expression: brow pulled down hard into a deep crease, eyes locked on that single lit screen and not on the camera, jaw muscle bunched, lips pressed into a thin flat line, a bead of sweat sliding at his temple, raking orange firelight lifting his face bright out of the dark room.

thumbnails.composition: 현장 장면 (야외 공개재판) + 제복 인물 클로즈업
thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄: 「겁주려고 연 재판인데 보러 온 청년들이 시큰둥하게 앉아 있다.」 2026.7 평안북도 신의주 련상동 20대 4명 공개재판, 참관 청년들이 '저 정도면 해볼 만하다'는 반응이었다는 데일리NK 2026.08.24 보도가 근거. 겁주기가 실패한 장면이므로 부정형. 피고인·관중은 전부 뒷모습 실루엣으로 두고 얼굴은 제복 경관에게만 준다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: the uniformed North Korean public-security officer is the largest thing in the picture — his head and shoulders occupy the entire right third of the frame, his face alone spans roughly the top 55 to 60 percent of the frame height, the top of his peaked cap touches the upper edge and is very slightly cropped by it, and his shoulder leaves the frame on the right. The seated crowd is far smaller, each head roughly one third of his head height. Scene: an open-air trial ground in a small North Korean city at dusk, photographed from the side of the stage. A vast North Korean flag — broad red band with a white circle bearing a red five-pointed star, thin white and blue stripes above and below — hangs as the backdrop across the entire left two-thirds of the frame, real heavy cloth, sun-bleached and dull, its lower edge torn into ragged strips. Under it a plain red banner strung above the stage reads "공개재판" in Korean Hangul in large clean characters. On the raised platform two young defendants in grey prison tunics stand with their backs to the camera, faces never visible, flanked by two small uniformed guards. Below them rows of young spectators are seen only as dark backs of heads and slumped shoulders, several leaning back and turned slightly away instead of watching. Dust, low haze and dirty orange sunset light pack every part of the frame; a hard vignette closes the corners. The officer stands at the right edge of the stage in front of the flag, no hands visible. His expression: eyes cut sideways toward the bored crowd rather than at the defendants, one eyebrow hitched high, mouth clamped shut with the corners dragged down, cheek muscle tight, a dull sheen of sweat on his forehead under the hard sidelight.

thumbnails.composition: 좌우 대비 (두 세계) + 제복 인물 클로즈업
thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄: 「강 하나 건너는 불바다인데 이쪽은 통째로 캄캄하고, 그 어둠 속 병사 주머니에서 화면 빛이 샌다.」 김강우 증언(중국 쪽은 화려, 북한 쪽은 가로등 하나 없음)과 군 내부 교육영상 자백(병사 휴대전화에 괴뢰 노래 160여 곡)이 근거. 글자를 다 지워도 어느 쪽이 이겼는지 밝기 덩어리만으로 읽히는 두 세계 구도로 짰다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: the young North Korean border sentry is the largest thing in the picture — his head and shoulders occupy the entire left third of the frame, his face alone spans roughly the top 55 to 60 percent of the frame height, the top of his fur-flap winter cap touches the upper edge and is very slightly cropped by it, and his shoulder leaves the frame on the left. The guard post and distant figures are far smaller, roughly one third of his head height. Scene: the North Korean bank of a frozen border river at night, camera standing on the North Korean side at eye level. The right half of the frame is the far Chinese bank — a dense wall of bright warm city lights, lit windows, street lamps and neon reflecting in the water, sharp and saturated. The left half, where the camera stands, is almost total blackness: unlit low houses, bare poles with no working lamps, a concrete guard post whose small signboard reads "국경초소" in Korean Hangul in large characters. Between the two banks a huge North Korean flag — broad red band with a white circle bearing a red five-pointed star, thin white and blue stripes above and below — hangs from a mast in the dark half, real woven fabric, scorched along one edge, its colour dead and greyed by the night. Cold haze and drifting smoke fill the gaps so no part of the frame is empty. The sentry stands in front of that flag with a rifle slung, one hand pushed into his chest pocket where a phone screen leaks a narrow cold blue light up under his jaw. His expression: eyes flicked hard sideways toward the glowing far bank, whites showing at the inner corners, lips parted just enough to show a breath in the cold, chin tucked down, eyebrows raised in the middle — the blue pocket light and the distant city glow together lift his face out of the black.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 확정 제목 후반부 「평양이 손전화를 걷어들인 진짜 이유」를 그대로 그림으로 옮긴 장. 2025.2 국가보위성 '중국 손전화 사용자를 박멸하라' 지시 → 2026.8 등록분까지 전량 회수까지의 결과물이 김정은 앞에 산으로 쌓여 있다. 핵이 아니라 손전화 더미 앞에서 낭패한 얼굴이라 부정형.
thumbnails.prompt_en: SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: Kim Jong Un (leader of North Korea) is the largest thing in the picture — his head and shoulders occupy the entire right third of the frame, his face alone spans roughly the top 55 to 60 percent of the frame height, the top of his hair touches the upper edge and is very slightly cropped by it, and his shoulder leaves the frame on the right. The uniformed aides behind him are far smaller, roughly one third of his head height. Scene: a night courtyard inside a Pyongyang compound. An enormous North Korean flag — broad red band with a white circle bearing a red five-pointed star, thin white and blue stripes above and below — fills the whole left half of the frame from top to bottom, real heavy cloth with deep photographic folds, its upper edge burning, flame eating along the fabric and thick black smoke pouring off it into a smoke-choked sky. At mid frame height, directly in front of the flag, sits a waist-high mountain of confiscated mobile phones, MP3 players and memory cards, thousands of dark handsets photographed with hard sharp detail, a plain wooden sign propped against the pile reading "전량회수" in Korean Hangul in large characters. Two small uniformed officers stand half-lost in the smoke behind the heap. Kim Jong Un stands immediately in front of the flag in a dark buttoned coat, no hands in frame, the fire behind him throwing a hard orange key light across his cheek. His expression: brow furrowed deep into three heavy lines, eyes cast down at the pile of phones and unfocused, lower lip pushed up and pressed hard against the upper, heavy beads of sweat along the hairline and one running down beside his ear, shoulders sunk. Fire orange and deep red drown the whole frame.

thumbnails.composition: 제복 집단 대열 (압수 상자를 들고 나오는 단속반)
thumbnails.concept_ko: 제목의 「걷어들인」을 동작으로 이행하는 장. 비사회주의 단속반이 인민반장 제보를 받고 살림집을 불시 수색해 컴퓨터·휴대전화·저장장치를 들고 나오는 실제 절차(데일리NK 2026.08.24)를 그대로 세웠다. 집단 대열이 정세형의 주력 구도이고, 손은 상자를 든 범주 B 동작이다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: the leading inspection-squad officer is the largest thing in the picture — his head and shoulders occupy the entire right third of the frame, his face alone spans roughly the top 55 to 60 percent of the frame height, the top of his cap touches the upper edge and is very slightly cropped by it, and his shoulder leaves the frame on the right. The officers behind him recede into the frame and grow progressively smaller and hazier, the furthest roughly one third of his head height. Scene: a narrow alley of low grey houses in a North Korean provincial town, shot at standing eye level as a column of uniformed non-socialist inspection officers walks out toward the camera carrying seized goods. Each man cradles a cardboard box of handsets, laptops and USB sticks held at chest height; from the seam of the nearest box a thin cold blue screen light leaks upward. Behind the column an enormous North Korean flag — broad red band with a white circle bearing a red five-pointed star, thin white and blue stripes above and below — is strung across the alley wall and fills more than half the frame, real woven fabric, stained, sun-bleached and torn at one corner. A paper directive pasted on the brick wall beside it reads "회수지시" in Korean Hangul in large characters. Smoke, hanging laundry lines and dust pack every gap in the upper five-eighths; a hard vignette darkens the corners and low fire glow rakes in from the right. The leading officer's expression: eyes narrowed to hard slits fixed straight ahead past the camera, nostrils flared, mouth set in a flat hard line with the jaw pushed forward, a vein standing at his temple, no sweat — cold and set rather than panicked.

thumbnails.composition: 좌우 대비 (근심하는 체제 vs 고개를 든 청년) — 화염 기둥으로 분할
thumbnails.concept_ko: 제목 전반부 「걸렸는데, 되레 큰소리쳤다」의 역전을 좌우 두 세계로 세운 장. 2026.2 혜산에서 보위원의 추궁에 '가사가 평소 생각과 같아서 꽂혔다'고 맞선 청년(데일리NK 2026.03.19)이 근거다. 청년은 무명 민간인이라 얼굴 없는 역광 실루엣으로만 두고, 얼굴은 국가원수 쪽에만 준다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: Kim Jong Un (leader of North Korea) is the largest thing in the picture — his head and shoulders occupy the entire left third of the frame, his face alone spans roughly the top 55 to 60 percent of the frame height, the top of his hair touches the upper edge and is very slightly cropped by it, and his shoulder leaves the frame on the left. The silhouetted figure on the right is far smaller, roughly one third of his head height. Scene: one frame split into two worlds by a vertical column of fire and black smoke running floor to ceiling down the middle. Left world: Kim Jong Un in a dark coat pressed directly against an enormous North Korean flag — broad red band with a white circle bearing a red five-pointed star, thin white and blue stripes above and below — that fills the whole left background, real heavy cloth, charred along its edges, colours grimy and dead, a cracked-glass fracture running through the fabric. Right world: a blacked-out North Korean village street at night, no street lamps, only a single unlit house window, and a lone young man standing in hard rim silhouette with his chin lifted and his back to us, face never visible, a cheap wired earphone cord running from his collar; a small propaganda board on the wall behind him reads "강연회" in Korean Hangul in large characters. Fire orange and deep red drown the left half while the right half stays near black, so the two worlds read as separate at a glance. Kim Jong Un's expression: eyes cast down and unfocused, brow pushed up in the middle into a worried crease, mouth slightly open as if a sentence stopped halfway, his own palm pressed flat against his forehead in a reflex he did not intend, shoulders sunk, hard orange firelight raking his face bright out of the smoke.

thumbnails.prompt_en: SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: Kim Jong Un (leader of North Korea) is the largest thing in the picture — his face fills the entire central third of the frame and alone spans roughly the top 55 to 60 percent of the frame height, the top of his hair touches the upper edge and is clearly cropped by it, and the shot is tight enough that his ears reach the panel boundaries. Everything in the left and right panels is far smaller, roughly one third of his head height. Scene: a single night frame divided into three vertical panels by smoke and light falloff rather than drawn lines. LEFT PANEL: a cluster of single-storey North Korean houses in total darkness with cheap solar panels bolted to their tin roofs and a car battery on a doorstep; every window is black except one, where a single phone screen glows cold blue behind the glass. CENTRE PANEL: Kim Jong Un's face in extreme close-up, pressed against an enormous North Korean flag — broad red band with a white circle bearing a red five-pointed star, thin white and blue stripes above and below — real woven fabric filling the whole background behind his head, flame eating along its upper edge, soot smeared through the folds. RIGHT PANEL: a desk stacked with handwritten neighbourhood-watch report papers, the top folder cover reading "보고서" in Korean Hangul in large characters while the individual lines beneath are printed too small and slightly out of focus to read; a uniformed safety officer stands beside it in profile, half swallowed by smoke. Fire orange and deep red drown the frame, black smoke packs every gap in the upper five-eighths, and the upper left and upper right corners stay dark and free of detail. Kim Jong Un's expression: eyes wide open and bulging with the whites fully showing, staring slightly off-camera to the left toward the one lit window, jaw clamped so hard the muscle stands out under the ear, lower lip sucked in, forehead shining with sweat, no hands in frame.
